import os
from pypdf import PdfReader

cwd = os.getcwd()
print("CWD:", cwd)
entries = sorted(os.listdir(cwd))
print("Entries:")
for e in entries:
    full = os.path.join(cwd, e)
    if os.path.isfile(full):
        print(" -", e, os.path.getsize(full), "bytes")
    else:
        print(" -", e, "[dir]")

candidates = [f for f in entries if f.lower() == "report.pdf"]
if candidates:
    path = candidates[0]
    reader = PdfReader(path)
    print("report.pdf found:", path)
    print("report.pdf pages:", len(reader.pages))
    first = reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    print("First page text (first 300 chars):", first[:300].replace("\n", " | "))
else:
    print("report.pdf NOT FOUND")

import os
from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

SRC = "report.pdf"
COVER = "_cover.pdf"
OUT = "_report_with_cover.pdf"

# 1) Create the cover page with reportlab
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
w, h = letter

# Accent bar at the top
c.setFillColorRGB(0.13, 0.23, 0.45)
c.rect(0, h - 130, w, 130, stroke=0, fill=1)
c.setFillColorRGB(1, 1, 1)
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(w / 2, h - 78, "Annual Financial Report")

# Current date centered below
today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.setFillColorRGB(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)
c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(w / 2, h / 2 - 40, today)

# Thin rule under the date
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.13, 0.23, 0.45)
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(w / 2 - 120, h / 2 - 65, w / 2 + 120, h / 2 - 65)

c.showPage()
c.save()
print("Cover created with date:", today)

# 2) Merge cover + original report
reader = PdfReader(SRC)
pages = list(reader.pages)  # materialize before overwriting source
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

# 3) Atomically replace report.pdf with the merged document
os.replace(OUT, SRC)
os.remove(COVER)

print("Merged. Total pages in report.pdf:", len(writer.pages))

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter, matches report.pdf

# Adobe Helvetica width tables (units of 1/1000 em) for the glyphs used
WIDTHS_REG = {
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278,
    **{str(d): 556 for d in range(10)},
    "A": 667, "B": 667, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278, "g": 556,
    "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222, "m": 833, "n": 556,
    "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556,
    "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
}
WIDTHS_BOLD = {
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278,
    **{str(d): 556 for d in range(10)},
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611, "M": 889, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333, "g": 611,
    "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 889, "n": 611,
    "o": 611, "p": 611, "q": 611, "r": 389, "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611,
    "v": 556, "w": 778, "x": 556, "y": 556, "z": 500,
}


def text_width(text, font_size, widths):
    return sum(widths.get(c, 500) for c in text) * font_size / 1000.0


def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def make_cover_pdf(title, date_str):
    """Build a minimal one-page PDF (US Letter) with title and date."""
    title_w = text_width(title, 30, WIDTHS_BOLD)
    date_w = text_width(date_str, 18, WIDTHS_REG)
    tx_title = (PAGE_W - title_w) / 2.0
    tx_date = (PAGE_W - date_w) / 2.0
    ty_title = 714.0   # baseline inside the top accent bar
    ty_date = 356.0    # vertical center of the page
    rule_y = 331.0

    content = (
        "q\n"
        "0.13 0.23 0.45 rg\n"
        f"0 {PAGE_H - 130} {PAGE_W} 130 re f\n"
        "Q\n"
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 30 Tf\n"
        "1 1 1 rg\n"
        f"{tx_title:.2f} {ty_title} Td\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_string(title)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "BT\n"
        "/F2 18 Tf\n"
        "0.15 0.15 0.15 rg\n"
        f"{tx_date:.2f} {ty_date} Td\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_string(date_str)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "0.13 0.23 0.45 RG\n"
        "2 w\n"
        f"{(PAGE_W - 240) / 2:.2f} {rule_y} m\n"
        f"{(PAGE_W + 240) / 2:.2f} {rule_y} l\n"
        "S\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = {
        1: b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        2: b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        3: (
            b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R "
            b"/MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
            b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> "
            b"/Contents 6 0 R >>"
        ),
        4: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        5: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        6: b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode("ascii") + b" >>\n"
            b"stream\n" + content + b"\nendstream",
    }

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objects):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode("ascii")
        out += objects[num]
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {len(objects) + 1}\n".encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in sorted(objects):
        out += f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii")
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode("ascii")
    return bytes(out)


def main():
    today_str = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print("Using date:", today_str)

    cover_bytes = make_cover_pdf("Annual Financial Report", today_str)

    # Validate the hand-built cover parses before merging
    cover_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes))
    print("Cover parses OK; cover pages:", len(cover_reader.pages))

    report_reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
    original_count = len(report_reader.pages)
    print("Original report pages:", original_count)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.append(cover_reader)
    writer.append(report_reader)

    tmp = "_report_with_cover.pdf"
    with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    os.replace(tmp, "report.pdf")

    print("Merged OK. New report.pdf pages:", len(writer.pages))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objects):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode("ascii")
        out += objects[num]
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {len(objects) + 1}\n".encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in sorted(objects):
        out += f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii")
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode("ascii")
    return bytes(out)


def main():
    today_str = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print("Using date:", today_str)

    cover_bytes = make_cover_pdf("Annual Financial Report", today_str)

    # Validate the hand-built cover parses before merging
    cover_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes))
    print("Cover parses OK; cover pages:", len(cover_reader.pages))

    report_reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
    original_count = len(report_reader.pages)
    print("Original report pages:", original_count)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.append(cover_reader)
    writer.append(report_reader)

    tmp = "_report_with_cover.pdf"
    with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    os.replace(tmp, "report.pdf")

    print("Merged OK. New report.pdf pages:", len(writer.pages))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
